rows.grounds: absolutive of pūj, indicating a completed act of worship prior to the main action
compound yathā+ukta qualifying the prescribed manner
instrumental noun denoting the prescribed procedure or rule
vocative compound addressing Śivā as dear to Hara

items.question: By what prescribed method should the beloved of Hara be worshipped?
premises: The act of worship is to be performed.
The worship must follow a stated method.
The beloved of Hara is the recipient of this worship.
items.inference: Therefore, the beloved of Hara should be worshipped according to the method as stated.
uncertainties: The specific details of the stated method are not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: O beloved of Hara, having worshipped you according to the method as stated.
